name: Exp_GG-RSI-CCI
summary: This EA trades based on signals from the GG-RSI-CCI custom indicator, which combines RSI and CCI with multi-layer smoothing. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend (value=2), sell positions on a downtrend signal (value=0), and optionally closes positions on a flat signal (value=1). Position sizing uses a deposit share model with configurable stop loss and take profit.
summary_zh: 该EA基于GG-RSI-CCI自定义指标的信号进行交易，该指标结合了RSI和CCI并经过多层平滑处理。当指标发出上升趋势信号（值=2）时开多仓，发出下降趋势信号（值=0）时开空仓，并在可选的平盘信号（值=1）时平仓。仓位管理采用存款比例模型，配有可配置的止损和止盈。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于GG-RSI-CCI指标，该指标将RSI和CCI两个动量振荡器结合，通过用户可选择的多层平滑算法（SMA、EMA、SMMA、JJMA、JurX等十种方法）进行双重平滑处理。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区1的值为2时产生买入信号，值为0时产生卖出信号，且当前信号与前一根K线信号不同时才开仓，避免重复入场。出场条件分为两种模式：MODE_FLAT模式下，指标值为1时同时平多仓和空仓；MODE_TREND模式下，仅在反向信号出现时才平仓（买入信号平空仓，卖出信号平多仓）。仓位管理采用MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表存款比例。资金管理通过StopLoss和TakeProfit参数实现固定点数止损止盈，同时设有价格偏差限制防止滑点过大。策略使用多周期框架，指标可在不同于图表的时间周期上运行，增强了灵活性。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the GG-RSI-CCI indicator, which combines two momentum oscillators (RSI and CCI) and applies double smoothing using a user-selectable algorithm from ten available methods (SMA, EMA, SMMA, JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA). Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when indicator buffer 1 value equals 2, a sell signal when it equals 0, and positions are only opened when the current signal differs from the previous bar's signal to prevent duplicate entries. Exit conditions operate in two modes: MODE_FLAT closes both long and short positions when the indicator value is 1 (flat/neutral), while MODE_TREND only closes positions on opposing trend signals (buy signal closes shorts, sell signal closes longs). Position sizing uses the MM parameter where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent a share of the deposit. Money management is implemented through fixed-point StopLoss and TakeProfit parameters, with a price deviation limit (Deviation_) to prevent excessive slippage. The strategy supports multi-timeframe operation, allowing the indicator to run on a timeframe different from the chart, enhancing flexibility in signal generation.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款比例或固定手数，负值为固定手数
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio controlling margin per trade

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格偏差点数（滑点限制）

parameters.name: BuyPosOpen
parameters.description_en: Allow opening long position on bullish signal

parameters.name: SellPosOpen
parameters.description_en: Allow opening short position on bearish signal

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow closing long position on reverse signal

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow closing short position on reverse signal

parameters.name: SignalMode
parameters.description: 平仓方式：趋势信号平仓或任意信号平仓
parameters.description_en: Close mode: trend signal or any signal

parameters.name: Smooth_Phase
parameters.description: 平滑参数（JJMA范围-100~+100，VIDYA为CMO周期，AMA为慢均线周期）
parameters.description_en: Smoothing parameter (JJMA: -100~+100, VIDYA: CMO period, AMA: slow MA period)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引
parameters.description_en: Trend bar index for signal judgment

pros: 结合RSI和CCI两个动量指标，信号经过多层平滑处理，减少了虚假信号
支持十种平滑算法选择，策略参数灵活可调，适应不同市场环境
提供两种出场模式（趋势和平盘），交易逻辑清晰且有信号去重机制避免重复开仓
多周期框架支持，指标可在高级别时间周期运行而图表在低级别，减少噪音干扰
设有开仓和平仓权限开关，便于分步测试和风险控制
pros_en: Combines RSI and CCI momentum indicators with multi-layer smoothing, reducing false signals
Supports ten smoothing algorithms with flexible parameters, adaptable to different market conditions
Provides two exit modes (trend and flat) with clear trading logic and signal deduplication to prevent duplicate entries
Multi-timeframe support allows the indicator to run on higher timeframes while the chart is on lower ones, reducing noise
Includes permission switches for opening and closing positions separately, facilitating stepwise testing and risk control
cons: 止损止盈为固定点数，未考虑ATR等波动性指标，在不同市场波动条件下可能不合适
缺少加仓、减仓和移动止损等高级仓位管理功能
依赖自定义指标GG-RSI-CCI和外部包含文件SmoothAlgorithms.mqh及TradeAlgorithms.mqh，若缺失则无法编译运行
MM参数为负值时作为固定手数的设计不够直观，容易造成用户误解
没有点差过滤和交易时间限制，在高点差时段或非活跃时段可能产生不利成交
cons_en: Stop loss and take profit use fixed points without considering ATR or volatility measures, potentially inappropriate under varying market volatility
Lacks advanced position management features such as scaling in/out, trailing stops, or break-even functionality
Depends on custom indicator GG-RSI-CCI and external include files SmoothAlgorithms.mqh and TradeAlgorithms.mqh, which if missing prevent compilation
The MM parameter design where negative values represent fixed lots is unintuitive and prone to user misunderstanding
No spread filter or trading session restrictions, which may lead to unfavorable fills during high-spread or low-liquidity periods
improvements: 将止损止盈改为基于ATR的动态计算，使其自适应市场波动性
增加点差过滤和交易时段限制，避免在高成本和低流动性时段交易
improvements_en: Replace fixed-point SL/TP with ATR-based dynamic calculation for self-adaptation to market volatility
Add spread filtering and trading session restrictions to avoid trading during high-cost and low-liquidity periods

risk_points: 固定点数止损止盈未考虑市场波动性变化，在极端行情中可能不足以保护资金
缺少点差过滤，在流动性差的市场条件下可能导致不必要的滑点损失
依赖外部自定义指标和包含文件，若文件不完整或版本不匹配可能导致EA运行异常
risk_points_en: Fixed-point SL/TP does not account for changing market volatility, potentially insufficient to protect capital in extreme conditions
No spread filter may lead to unnecessary slippage losses in low-liquidity market conditions
Dependency on external custom indicators and include files may cause runtime anomalies if files are incomplete or version-mismatched
